# Novaris

> Novaris is a student STEM Racing (formerly F1 in Schools) team from Trinity Grammar School in Kew, Melbourne, Australia. Its car, NV-45 Redshift, won the Fastest Car award with a time of 1.068 seconds at the 2026 STEM Racing World Finals in Singapore, where Novaris placed 14th of 91 teams.

## Results
- 2026 STEM Racing World Finals, Singapore (October 2026): Fastest Car award (1.068 s); 14th of 91 teams overall on 729.6 points.
- 2026 Australian National Finals, Development Class: National Champions, Knockout Racing Champions, Grand Prix Racing Champions, Best Manufactured Car.

## Pages
- [Home](https://team-novaris.com/): about the team, results, the NV-45 Redshift car, team members and partners
- [Gallery](https://team-novaris.com/gallery.html): 42 photos from the team workshop, the 2026 Australian National Finals and the 2026 World Finals
